Sends custom headers on same-host crawl requests

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import CrawlConfig, crawl, create_engine

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(
        custom_headers={"Accept-Language": "en-US", "X-Custom-Header": "test-value"},
        max_depth=1,
        respect_robots_txt=False,
        subdomain_header_allowlist=["Accept-Language"],
    )
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await crawl(engine, url)
    print(len(result.pages))

asyncio.run(main())
```
